verdict.rationale: React components are written in JavaScript (with TypeScript support) using JSX, an HTML-like markup syntax. React can also be added to an existing HTML page. However, the docs themselves describe JSX as a non-standard "JavaScript syntax extension popularized by React" rather than standard markup, and they introduce React-specific concepts such as component state, hooks rules enforced by lint, and 'use client' directives. Missing for 10: evidence of using standard CSS/styling approaches, use of standard HTML markup rather than a JSX extension, any evidence of a minimal-new-concepts learning curve, and independent hands-on corroboration of ease of learning.
